```powershell

Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -match 'cyber' -or $_.MainWindowTitle -match 'Cyberpunk' } | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('CYBERPROC ' + $_.ProcessName + ' pid=' + $_.Id + ' title=' + $_.MainWindowTitle) }

if (Test-Path $p537games) { Get-Content $p537games | Where-Object { $_ -match 'Cyberpunk' } | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('GAMEROW ' + $_) } } else { Write-Output 'GAMEROW FILE MISSING' }
```
